title: MSW Mock Coverage for Backend Routes

sprint.goal: Add MSW (Mock Service Worker) handlers for all unmocked backend routes so that frontend integration tests can exercise every API path without a running server
stories: S1: Core domain MSW handlers (movies, series, indexers)
S5: Remaining domains (backups, blocklist, calendar, collections, updates)
sprint.demo_notes: Show frontend integration tests passing against MSW handlers for every domain; no direct fetch calls to localhost needed
